title: Neural Schr\"{o}dinger Bridge via Yasue Action with Applications to Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.28623v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a novel neural solver for inferring the continuous state evolution of the Schr\"{o}dinger bridge problem. The proposed solver builds on a saddle point formulation involving the Yasue action functional. This allows us to realize the continuous state evolution by learning the optimal velocity for an ordinary differential equation, as opposed to learning the optimal drift for a stochastic differential equation. The proposed solver only uses the source and the target samples, and not the source and target distributions per se, which makes it particularly suitable for high dimensional applications arising in generative modeling. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed solver using several numerical experiments in low and high dimensions, using both real and synthetic datasets.

translated_title: 基于Yasue作用的神经薛定谔桥及其在生成建模中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的神经求解器，用于推断薛定谔桥问题的连续状态演化。该求解器建立在涉及Yasue作用泛函的鞍点公式化之上。这使得我们能够通过学习常微分方程的最优速度来实现连续状态演化，而无需学习随机微分方程的最优漂移。所提出的求解器仅使用源样本和目标样本，而不需要源分布和目标分布本身，这使其特别适合生成建模中出现的高维应用。我们通过在低维和高维空间中、使用真实和合成数据集的多个数值实验，证明了所提出求解器的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Yasue作用泛函鞍点公式的神经求解器，通过学习常微分方程的最优速度（而非随机微分方程的漂移）来求解薛定谔桥问题，且仅需源和目标样本即可运行，因此特别适用于高维生成建模任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel neural solver for the Schrödinger bridge problem based on a saddle point formulation involving the Yasue action, which learns the optimal velocity of an ODE rather than the drift of an SDE, requiring only source and target samples and thus making it particularly suitable for high-dimensional generative modeling.
